window: 4 AM Tue 3 Nov to 4 AM Wed 4 Nov IST
headline: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana led yesterday with 160K tickets, up 45% on the day before, ahead of its Thu 5 Nov release.
bullets: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana was the top film with 160K tickets, up 45% on the day before, and its busiest hour was 9:55 PM at 12.48K.
Scene and Scene (Telugu) were tied for second and third at 88.5K each, with Scene's busiest hour at 11:26 PM and Scene (Telugu)'s at 11:35 PM.
Jailer 2 was 4th at 34.7K, down 18% on the day before, and Aadarsha Kutumbam was 5th at 32.9K, down 35%.
On interest, Scene gained 41K in 24 hours to 267K+ before its Fri 6 Nov release, and Namit Malhotra's Ramayana gained 20K to 591K+ with bookings open.
